name: Strawberry Swirl Ice Cream Cone
description: A strawberry swirl ice cream cone is a delightful treat featuring creamy vanilla ice cream swirled with bits of vibrant, tangy strawberry. The ice cream is served on a crispy waffle cone, providing a delicious contrast of textures and flavors. The combination of sweet vanilla and tart strawberry creates a refreshing and satisfying dessert that is perfect for any occasion.
